Package hadur.bench

Class Exclusions

java.lang.Object
hadur.bench.Exclusions
final class Exclusions extends Object
BENCH-63: the opponents that failed all, or at least half, of their battles, so a set that quietly shrank says so at the top of its report. Pure: no battle is started here.
